refnamediv.refpurpose: Identify the type of a linear phase FIR filter.

listitem.para: Integer. The type of the FIR filter. Can be 1, 2, 3, or 4.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function determines the type, `t`, of a linear phase FIR filter with coefficients `b`. The filter must be real and have linear phase. The type is determined as follows: - Type 1: Symmetrical coefficients with an odd length. - Type 2: Symmetrical coefficients with an even length. - Type 3: Anti-symmetrical coefficients with an odd length. - Type 4: Anti-symmetrical coefficients with an even length.
If the filter does not have linear phase, the function returns `t = -1`.
